title: Bacteriophage DNA Organic Extraction
author: Fabian Kunisch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1955/v1
materials: Using a spectrophotometer (e.g., NanoDrop 1000 Spectrophotometer; Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, USA; cat. no.: ND-1000), the concentration of phage DNA and its purity can be evaluated.

steps.title: Add phage stock
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of phage stock solution (10⁹–10¹⁰ PFU/ml) to a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add nucleases
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl DNase I (1 mg/ml) and 10 µl RNase A (5 mg/ml) to the tube.

steps.title: Incubate with nucleases
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a shaker thermoblock and incubate for 60 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Add EDTA
steps.instruction: Add 40 µl of 0.5 M EDTA‑Na₂ to the tube.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µl of Proteinase K (20 mg/ml) to the tube.

steps.title: Add SDS
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of 10 % SDS to the tube.

steps.title: Incubate with Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a shaker thermoblock and incubate for 1 h at 56 °C.

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the tube to cool to room temperature (approximately 20 min).

steps.title: Transfer to large tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume from the microcentrifuge tube into a 15 ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add phenol
steps.instruction: Add 1.1 ml phenol, seal the tube with its lid, and invert 5 times to mix.

steps.title: Phenol centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 min at 22 °C and 4,000 g.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 15 ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol/chloroform (50:50) to the aqueous phase (e.g., for 0.9 ml add 450 µl phenol and 450 µl chloroform) and invert to mix.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 min at 22 °C and 4,000 g.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase again
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 15 ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add chloroform
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform to the aqueous phase (e.g., for 700 µl add 700 µl chloroform) and invert to mix.

steps.title: Chloroform centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 min at 22 °C and 4,000 g.

steps.title: Repeat chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of chloroform (step 15) and centrifugation (step 16).

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer a maximum of 550 µl of the upper aqueous phase into a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add a maximum of 55 µl sodium acetate (1/10 of the volume transferred in the previous step).

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add a maximum of 1 375 µl (2.5 × the volume after step 20) of 95 % ethanol.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 30 min on ice in a –20 °C freezer.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 20 min at 4 °C and 14,000 g.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and add 2 ml of 70 % ethanol to the tube.

steps.title: Ethanol wash mixing
steps.instruction: Invert the tube 10 times and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second ethanol centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 min at 4 °C and 14,000 g.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and let the pellet air‑dry for approximately 20 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 20 µl ddH₂O.

steps.title: Store DNA solution
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at 4 °C until further use.
